name: Narahara Chisa
source: [url=/c58417]Masaharu's[/url] well-endowed classmate who is very shy around boys, and can't talk to them unless she has another female friend around her. Chisa however does want to fall in love someday. Because she lacks a presence, Masaharu had no idea of her and because she also kept her distance from him.
